<noinclude>
== Usage ==
<pre>
{{avatarian|hello}}
{{avatarian|hello|ipa=h ɛ l oʊ}}
</pre>
* First parameter: English text to auto-convert (uses the same
  approximate G2P as the standalone translator — good for common words,
  rougher on names/loanwords).
* Optional <code>ipa=</code> parameter: give the exact IPA yourself
  (space-separated symbols) to bypass the English guesser entirely —
  use this whenever you already know the right pronunciation.

This template does not draw anything by itself. It just marks the
text; a script loaded from [[MediaWiki:Common.js]] finds every
<code>.avatarian-word</code> span on the page after it loads and
replaces it with the real glyphs, using the exact same rendering code
as the standalone translator site. If JavaScript is disabled, the
raw English text is shown instead (never a blank space).
</noinclude><includeonly><span class="avatarian-word" data-avatarian-text="{{{1|}}}" data-avatarian-ipa="{{{ipa|}}}">{{{1}}}</span></includeonly>
